verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships a single-binary CLI/server and clickhouse-local that install and run headlessly via `curl | sh` with no account/keys, verified in a runtime probe executing a full SQL roundtrip non-interactively; it also has HTTP interface with scriptable format headers, making it straightforward to script in CI. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) or dedicated 'headless/automation' doc section beyond install + local usage.
